part.name: Elongated blind-bore latch or lever body
part.description: Single-piece solid body comprising a long rectangular arm, a larger rounded head, an axial blind cylindrical bore opening at the free end, and a localized underside relief pocket. Broad planar load-carrying surfaces are joined by cylindrical, spherical, conical, and spline corner blends.
part.symmetry_note: The long arm is approximately regular about its longitudinal direction, but the raised rounded head, underside pocket, blind bore termination, and unequal edge treatments prevent full mirror symmetry.

Section.name: Main elongated arm
features included: Stepped junction with the enlarged head
Section.function intent: Provides the primary reach and load path between the enlarged head and the free-end interface while surrounding and supporting the axial bore.
Section.physical behavior: Acts principally as a deep rectangular beam. Its broad upper and lower skins resist bending, the side walls resist shear and torsion, and the rounded or beveled perimeter transitions reduce edge stress concentrations and impact sensitivity.
Section.geometry: An elongated, mostly prismatic rectangular body extending from the head toward the free end. The arm has large planar skins, locally rounded plan-view corners, narrow beveled edge strips, and a stepped transition where it meets the head.
Section.location: Central and free-end portion of the part, extending longitudinally away from the enlarged rounded head.

major_faces.name: Head-side shoulder wall
major_faces.description: Planar transverse shoulder at the arm-to-head transition, spanning most of the part thickness.

major_faces.name: Long outer side wall
major_faces.description: Large planar longitudinal wall forming one principal side of the arm.

major_faces.name: Outer end corner fillet
major_faces.description: Large-radius cylindrical patch blending the long side wall into the free-end region.

major_faces.name: Free-end interface face
major_faces.description: Planar terminal face at the free end; it contains the opening of the internal axial bore.

major_faces.name: End-side planar strip
major_faces.description: Narrow planar longitudinal patch adjacent to the free-end face and a large rounded transition.

major_faces.name: Lower end transition
major_faces.description: Large cylindrical surface joining the end-side region to the opposite longitudinal side.

major_faces.name: Opposite long side wall
major_faces.description: Broad planar longitudinal wall opposite the main outer side, locally interrupted by the bore boundary.

major_faces.name: Lower longitudinal bevel
major_faces.description: Narrow diagonal planar strip transitioning from the opposite side wall to the bottom skin.

major_faces.name: Main bottom skin
major_faces.description: Large planar underside surface of the arm extending toward the free end.

major_faces.name: Free-end bottom bevel
major_faces.description: Diagonal planar band connecting the bottom skin with the terminal end and corner treatment.

major_faces.name: Main top skin
major_faces.description: Largest planar upper surface, visually continuous across much of the arm and part of the head.

major_faces.name: Upper longitudinal bevel
major_faces.description: Narrow diagonal planar strip connecting the top skin to the opposite longitudinal wall.

Section.name: Axial blind bore
Section.function intent: Receives and radially locates a cylindrical mating pin, shaft, spring, or tool while limiting its insertion depth at the blind end.
Section.physical behavior: The cylindrical wall provides radial constraint and bearing contact along the arm axis. The planar blind end provides an axial stop and transfers insertion or operating force into the surrounding arm and head junction.
Section.geometry: A straight cylindrical cavity extending longitudinally from the free-end face toward the head. The cavity is open at the free end and closed by a circular planar floor near the arm-to-head transition.
Section.location: Inside the main arm, centered near the free-end face and extending toward the enlarged head.

major_faces.name: Bore cylindrical wall
major_faces.description: Long internal cylinder of radius approximately 14.14 mm forming the principal mating interface.

major_faces.name: Bore blind floor
major_faces.description: Circular planar end surface closing the bore and defining its insertion depth.

Section.name: Underside relief pocket
Section.function intent: Provides localized clearance for an adjacent component or moving latch element and may reduce mass without opening the axial bore.
Section.physical behavior: Removes material from a comparatively low-demand region while retaining surrounding side webs. The pocket walls laterally guide or clear a mating element, and its roof and end surfaces arrest excessive travel or contact.
Section.geometry: A localized rectangular or trapezoidal underside recess bounded by two transverse side walls, a broad internal roof, a shorter lower face, and an end wall with a non-rectangular boundary.
Section.location: On the underside of the central arm, between the head and the free end.

major_faces.name: Pocket first side wall
major_faces.description: Planar transverse wall forming one lateral boundary of the underside recess.

major_faces.name: Pocket upper end wall
major_faces.description: Planar end surface closing the deeper portion of the recess.

major_faces.name: Pocket roof
major_faces.description: Broad planar internal surface forming the roof of the underside pocket.

major_faces.name: Pocket second side wall
major_faces.description: Planar transverse wall opposite the first pocket side wall.

major_faces.name: Pocket lower ledge
major_faces.description: Short planar surface forming a lower ledge or partial floor at one end of the recess.

Section.name: Enlarged rounded head
Section.function intent: Forms the enlarged load-input, grip, stop, or mounting region and spreads forces from the arm into a larger volume with impact-safe external corners.
Section.physical behavior: Its increased cross-section raises local bending and contact stiffness. Large-radius cylindrical and spherical corners distribute stress, reduce snagging, and improve impact resistance, while the planar walls provide potential stop or mounting interfaces.
Section.geometry: A block-like enlarged head at one end of the arm. It has broad planar side and end regions, a rounded lower profile, multiple radius-30 cylindrical perimeter patches, smaller radius-5 edge bands, and spherical or spline corner blends.
Section.location: At the enlarged end of the part, opposite the arm's bore opening.

major_faces.name: Head front planar wall
major_faces.description: Rectangular planar terminal wall between two large rounded vertical corners.

major_faces.name: Head front-side round
major_faces.description: Large radius-30 cylindrical patch blending the front wall into the outer side wall.

major_faces.name: Head outer side wall
major_faces.description: Broad planar wall on the extreme side of the enlarged head.

major_faces.name: Head rear-side round
major_faces.description: Large radius-30 cylindrical corner joining the outer side to the rear wall.

major_faces.name: Head rear planar wall
major_faces.description: Large planar rear wall extending through nearly the full head thickness.

major_faces.name: Head rear vertical fillet
major_faces.description: Small radius-5 cylindrical edge band between the rear wall and the arm-side shoulder region.

major_faces.name: Head arm-side bottom fillet
major_faces.description: Small cylindrical edge blend running along the lower arm-side boundary of the head.

major_faces.name: Head bottom plane
major_faces.description: Broad planar underside facet of the enlarged head.

major_faces.name: Head rear-bottom fillet
major_faces.description: Small radius-5 cylindrical band joining the bottom plane to the rear wall.

major_faces.name: Head side-bottom round
major_faces.description: Large radius-30 cylindrical surface forming the rounded lower side of the head.

major_faces.name: Head spherical corner
major_faces.description: Large spherical octant-like patch blending three mutually adjacent rounded head regions.

major_faces.name: Head front-bottom round
major_faces.description: Large radius-30 cylindrical patch connecting the front wall to the bottom region.

major_faces.name: Head arm-junction round
major_faces.description: Large cylindrical transition blending the rounded head into the narrower arm-side geometry.
